profile.role_note: Havoc Bane support for Negative Status teams; built for uptime, not peak damage.

pull_verdict.verdict: One of the best supports for Negative Status teams, finally in her element — worth it if you're building around Hsin or status squads; an easy skip if your sustain slots are already covered.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Lustrous Razor (free) or Kumokiri (signature) + 3-pc Thread of Severed Fate / 2-pc Midnight Veil in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Aim for ~125% Energy Regen, Crit on the 4-cost, Havoc DMG on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs. Level Liberation first.

ranked_weapons.name: Kumokiri
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat. +12% ATK; Intro Skill or inflicting Negative Status stacks +8% Liberation DMG up to 3 times, and at max stacks grants the team 24% All-Attribute DMG for 15s. Best in slot by a clear margin.

ranked_weapons.name: Wildfire Mark
ranked_weapons.note: Crit DMG substat. +12% ATK; Intro or Liberation grants +24% Liberation DMG for 6s (extended by heavy attacks). Strong second place.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: ATK substat. Free from the standard Convene; high ATK plus Liberation DMG and energy for ultimate uptime. The budget king — community testing puts it within a few percent of the signature for team contribution.

echo_sets.name: Thread of Severed Fate + Midnight Veil
echo_sets.note: 3-pc: +20% ATK and +30% Resonance Liberation DMG for 5s whenever she inflicts Havoc Bane — tailor-made for her kit. (Sun-sinking Eclipse or Havoc Eclipse work as the 2-pc.) Main Echo gives +12% Havoc DMG and +12% Resonance Liberation DMG, amplified against enemies afflicted with Havoc Bane.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Healer alternative: +10% energy for her, +10% ATK for the team. Take only if running her as a pure sustain; you give up a lot of her offensive utility.

stat_priorities.note: Crit Rate, or Crit DMG if substats already cover rate.
Havoc DMG Bonus on both by default; the second piece can be ATK% if its substats are clearly better.

build.weapon_filler_note: No 4-star broadblade stands out in community testing. Use any 4-star with ATK% or Crit substats as a placeholder until one of the ranked 5-stars drops.

teams.name: Hsin Electro Flare team — 3.7's top pick

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The main DPS who detonates Electro Flare stacks for her big bursts. Fire Chisa's Outro into Hsin right before her big damage window.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: The sub-DPS engine — applies Flare stacks in bulk, and his kit has a unique interaction with Hsin that gives both of them an Electro damage bonus.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: The support: her Outro raises the Flare stack cap so Hsin's detonations hit harder, her Havoc Bane shreds enemy defense, and she covers healing and shielding. (Suisui is the smoother default here; Chisa is the more hands-on, more offensive alternative.)

teams.rotation: Open with Electro Rover to lay down Flare stacks, bring Chisa in briefly to apply Unseen Snare and heal, then swap to Hsin — build resources, then detonate with her Resonance Liberation. Use Chisa's Outro into Hsin before her big damage window. Don't run Chisa and Suisui together: their stack-cap effects don't stack.

teams.name: Aero Erosion team — the proven classic

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: The main DPS: her ultimate consumes Aero Erosion stacks on the enemy for bonus damage per stack, so more stacks means bigger hits. Still rated as her best team across community guides.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Applies and maintains Aero Erosion off-field while adding Aero damage buffs — effectively required for Cartethyia at low investment.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Raises the Erosion stack cap by 3 via her Outro, adds defense shred, and heals and shields more consistently than the free alternative, Aero Rover.

teams.rotation: Start with Chisa to apply Unseen Snare, switch to Ciaccona to build up Erosion stacks, then fire Chisa's Outro into Cartethyia and unleash her Liberation at maximum stacks.

teams.name: F2P starter: Spectro Rover team

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: The free 5-star on-field damage dealer. Applies Spectro Frazzle, which triggers Chisa's defense shred and benefits from her stack-cap raise.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Her usual support role: defense shred, healing, shielding, and stack amplification for Rover's Frazzle.

members.name: Verina
members.note: The healer and buffer — tops up the team's health and hands out team-wide damage buffs so Rover hits harder.

teams.rotation: Open with Verina for buffs, tag in Chisa to apply Unseen Snare, then stay on Spectro Rover for the damage phase — swap Chisa back in to heal or fire her Outro whenever Rover's Frazzle stacks are maxed.

Team 50% All-Attribute DMG via Thread of Bane — the cost-performance pick (ldshop, wuwabuild).
Cheat-death plus 30% negative-status amp and 40% more Chisa damage.
